topicTitle: 4.1 Order and Degree of Differential Equations
answer: A differential equation is an equation containing one or more derivatives of an unknown function.
The order is the order of the highest-order derivative present in the equation.
prompt: How is the order of a differential equation determined?

answer: A solution is any function defined on an interval that reduces the differential equation to an identity.
